facts.text: Jon has been involved in dancing since childhood and considers it a passion and escape.

evidence.quote: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape.

facts.text: Jon intends to start a dance studio to teach others about the joy of dancing.

evidence.quote: I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.
I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.

facts.text: Jon's favorite dance style is contemporary, which he finds expressive and powerful.

evidence.quote: I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful!

facts.text: Gina also finds contemporary dance expressive and graceful, and it speaks to her.

evidence.quote: Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.
